questions.question: Communication between a computer and a keyboard involves ........... transmission.
questions.explanation: Keyboard to computer communication is one-way only, which is simplex transmission.

questions.question: While creating a table, which constraint does not allow insertion of duplicate values in the table?
questions.explanation: The UNIQUE constraint prevents duplicate values in a column. DISTINCT only removes duplicates from query results, NOT NULL forbids nulls, and HAVING filters groups.

questions.question: An endpoint of an inter-process communication flow across a computer network is called

options.D: More than one of the above

questions.explanation: A socket (IP address + port) is the endpoint of an inter-process communication flow across a network. A port alone is just a number, and a pipe is local IPC.

questions.question: Auxiliary storage space management in an operating system involves:

options.B: Managing input/output operations between processes and devices
options.C: Managing the allocation of memory to processes
options.D: Managing the allocation of space on secondary storage devices

questions.explanation: Auxiliary storage management handles free-space management and allocation of space on secondary storage such as disks. Allocating main memory to processes is memory management.

questions.question: What is the full form of FTP ?
questions.explanation: FTP stands for File Transfer Protocol, used to transfer files between client and server.

questions.question: The recurrence equation T(n) = T(n/2) + T(n/3) + n represents the time complexity of which algorithmic paradigm?
questions.explanation: T(n) = T(n/2) + T(n/3) + n splits the problem into smaller subproblems solved recursively and combines them in linear time, the hallmark of divide and conquer. Backtracking explores choices and undoes them, which this recurrence does not describe.

questions.question: Which of the following is the correct expansion of SMS?
questions.explanation: SMS stands for Short Message Service, the text messaging service of mobile networks.

questions.question: Who is the inventor of the "Difference Engine"?
questions.explanation: Charles Babbage designed the Difference Engine (1822). Ada Lovelace wrote programs for his Analytical Engine; Turing and Cray came much later.

questions.question: Which sublayer of the data link layer performs data link functions that depend upon the type of medium?

options.D: More than one of the above

questions.explanation: The MAC sublayer handles medium-dependent functions such as access control and framing for the specific medium. The LLC sublayer provides medium-independent functions.

questions.question: Which of the following SQL commands is used to view data?
questions.explanation: SELECT retrieves (views) data from tables. CREATE defines objects, INSERT adds rows, UPDATE modifies rows.

questions.question: Which one of the following is not used in media access control?
questions.explanation: Ethernet, DSL and FDDI all use media access control mechanisms, so none of these is the answer.

questions.question: How many select lines are required for an 8-to-1 multiplexer?

options.D: More than one of the above

questions.explanation: An 8-to-1 MUX needs log2(8) = 3 select lines. 2 select lines handle only 4 inputs.

questions.question: Which device is used to connect multiple devices within the same local area network (LAN)?

options.D: More than one of the above

questions.explanation: A switch connects multiple devices within the same LAN and forwards frames using MAC addresses. A router connects different networks; a bridge typically joins two LAN segments.

questions.question: PDA can be represented with the help of
questions.explanation: A PDA can be represented by a transition table, a transition diagram, and its configurations by instantaneous descriptions. All three are valid.

questions.question: What is the main purpose of inheritance in OOP?

options.C: To establish a parent-child relationship between classes

questions.explanation: Inheritance lets a child (derived) class acquire the properties and methods of a parent (base) class, creating an is-a relationship. Creating instances is instantiation, not inheritance.

questions.question: What is the purpose of error control in the Data Link Layer?

options.B: To correct errors in the physical layer

questions.explanation: Error control (detection and retransmission, e.g. ARQ) ensures frames are delivered reliably between adjacent nodes. Congestion control and access control are separate functions.

questions.question: The term "NTFS" refers to which one of the following?
questions.explanation: NTFS stands for New Technology File System, the Windows NT family file system. The other expansions are invented.

questions.question: Which of the following is the advantage of the array data structure?

options.A: Elements of mixed data types can be stored
options.B: Easier to access the elements in an array
options.C: Index of the first element starts from 1
options.D: More than one of the above

questions.explanation: Array elements are stored contiguously and accessed directly by index in O(1) time. Arrays hold elements of a single type, and in most languages indexing starts at 0.

questions.question: Which type of data can be stored in the database?

options.C: Data in the form of audio or video
options.D: More than one of the above

questions.explanation: Modern databases can store text and files, images, and audio/video (e.g. as BLOBs). Since all of A, B and C are possible, the answer is 'More than one of the above'.

questions.question: Which of the cell pointers indicates that you can fill series?

options.C: Mouse Pointer with anchor at the tip

questions.explanation: The small thin black plus appears over the fill handle and indicates you can drag to fill a series. The big white plus is for selection.

questions.question: Which of the following is a correct identifier?
questions.explanation: Python keywords are case-sensitive, so 'Break' is a valid identifier while 'break' is not. 'global', 'def' and 'with' are reserved keywords.

questions.question: The simplified form of the Boolean expression (X + Y + XY)(X + Z) is

options.D: More than one of the above

questions.explanation: X + Y + XY = X + Y (absorption). Then (X + Y)(X + Z) = X + YZ by the distributive law.

questions.question: Reverse engineering is primarily used for:
questions.explanation: Reverse engineering analyses existing software to understand its design and produce documentation or higher-level representations. Building new software from scratch is forward engineering.

questions.question: Which version of IP address is most suitable for IoT?
questions.explanation: IPv6 offers a 128-bit address space large enough to give every IoT device its own address. IPv5 and IPv7 are not deployed versions, and IPv4 addresses are exhausted.

questions.question: What is the primary role of the memory-mapped I/O technique in a microcontroller?

options.A: It increases the speed of program execution
options.B: It provides additional memory space for data storage
options.C: It allows external devices to access the microcontroller's memory
options.D: It eliminates the need for I/O operations

questions.explanation: In memory-mapped I/O, device registers share the same address space as memory, so devices and memory are accessed with the same load/store instructions; option C is the closest description. It does not add storage or remove I/O operations.
